reason: Fixed only in Pillow 13.0.0, but gradio (6.30.0 and earlier) requires pillow<13. The flaws are in PDF/GIF/TIFF/EPS decoding and ImageMorph. The app listens on 127.0.0.1 only, accepts video and .json uploads only, and calls Pillow only for ImageFont, so none of these code paths is reachable. Remove this entry once gradio allows Pillow 13.
